history.summary: The deterministic, rights-bound pilot pack validates against the external private unblinding evidence, but no v2 evaluator, isolated ingestion, or deployment exists. The Builder commit locally implements and tests the isolated v2 evaluator, pack, private ingestion, and v1 relocation, but it is not pushed or deployed: production /evaluate still serves v17 and /evaluate-v1 is 404. No authorized Blob count, fresh v2 submission, validation, deletion, PR, CI, merge, or deployment evidence exists.

All local gates passed and the deployed v2/v1 routes, controlled Jamendo playback, isolated state/API, zero-count lifecycle evidence, PR #36/CI/merge/deployment, and protected recommender hashes were independently verified.
